title: Evolution of the radius of analyticity for mKdV-type equations
summary: In this paper, we obtain new lower bounds for the evolution of the radius of analyticity of solutions to two initial value problems (IVPs) with initial data belonging to the class of analytic functions $H^{σ,s}(\mathbb{R})$ defined via a hyperbolic cosine weight. First, we consider the IVP for the modified Korteweg-de Vries (mKdV) equation. For this problem, we prove that the evolution of the radius of analyticity $σ(T)$ of the solution admits an algebraic lower bound $cT^{-\frac 12}$ for some $c>0$ and given arbitrarily large $T>0$.
